title: A machine-learning-powered spectral-dominant multimodal soft wearable system for long-term and early-stage diagnosis of plant stresses.
summary: A multimodal soft wearable system with machine learning detects early plant stress from spectral-dominant physiological signals over time. The source tests sensor signals against controlled plant-stress conditions and reports classification of stress states in tomato plants. Testing: Controlled plant conditions and limited species/stress types constrain field generalization..
